title: 第八章 好一击回旋踢第七章 我也喜欢
lines: 就在此时，赵悠儿忽然向前一步，躲开安禄山之爪，以行李箱为轴，一个回身，一脚踢了出去，斜向上四十五度！
下巴遭受重创的墨镜男应声倒地，抱着脑袋哼哼唧唧。李牧等人已经赶到，也是瞠目结舌，这记回旋踢相当的可以啊，原来不仅仅是修长……
“瞎了你的狗眼，跑到我们学校门口耍流氓，找死是不是！”李牧等人毫不客气的追上去一顿补脚，这混蛋当沪政男生都死光了吗。
“嘿！好啊！你们是一伙儿的！想仙人跳哥哥是不是？好！等着，有你们好受的！”倒在地上的墨镜男拿出手机开始拍照，“大学生打人，你们好啊！老子在公安可有人！你们等着，不告到你们退学老子就跟你们姓！”
小白几个人面面相觑，这他娘的遇上老赖了，他们倒不怕，可赵悠儿是来沪政留学的，可不能学校门还没进，就先背个处分啊。
正在大家犹豫的时候，李牧笑了，笑的很开心，“啧啧，活久见啊，傻子，看看那门牌，这是什么学校！”
“沪……沪东政法大学啊。”墨镜男呆了呆，……不是艺术学院……
长成这样竟然不搞艺术？？？
“见过蠢的，没见过耍流氓耍到这里的。”李牧冲墨镜男满不在乎的挥挥手，之后又向路口的红绿灯指了指，“车停在人行道上，逆行倒车。你可以啊！监控区域知道吗？这地方还需要用手机拍照？强制猥亵，还是大庭广众，这是从重情节啊，哥几个，我们都是证人，这要判多少年来着，给他免费普普法！”
“按照刑法第二百三十七条，你这种行为五年左右吧，没事，出来之后还是一条好汉！”小白配合默契，立刻接过去说道，其实他哪儿记的这么清楚。
“哥们，你身段还不错啊，还挺白，进去之后应该会受欢迎的。”司马仪坏笑道，说的墨镜男菊花一紧，他的某些部位更白。
“别跟他bb，直接110，这种社会渣滓早就应该回收了！”范建国直接掏出手机。
墨镜男脸色惨白，他不傻，并不觉得自己事儿有多大，什么便宜没占到就被暴打一顿，这就跟碰瓷撞上警察一样，“几位大哥，我错了，真的错了，再也不敢了，我走，我马上走。”
赖在地上的墨镜男一咕噜爬起来，三步并做两步跳上车，一溜烟的开着车走了，想来以后他路过这里都会绕道走吧。
“谢谢，四位学长，这里是沪东政法东门对吧？”赵悠儿打量着四人，露出灿烂的笑容还有赏心悦目的小白牙，鞠躬说道。
四人都愣了愣，这一笑真有点倾国倾城的气质，美丽的大眼睛透着一股子狡黠，美是一方面，赵悠儿身上确实带着一种说不出的范儿，让人忍不住想要亲近。
这绝对是个不好对付的精灵学妹。
“悠悠，几年没见变成大美女了，怎么认不出了，我是白启！”小白忍不住笑道，这丫头竟然还没认出来。
“小白哥，逗你的，你要在来晚点，我可就危险了。”赵悠儿说道。
“我们来晚点，他就危险了吧。”李牧忍不住说道，这姑娘绝对是个有脾气的，大多数人骂走对方就不错了，她上来就是个ko，不过，真的很痛快。
“刚刚那招帅啊，走位，回旋踢，一气呵成，有盲僧的风采！”司马仪忍不住夸赞道，可惜啊，他是有主儿的人，否则这样的美女一定追啊。
司马仪同学虽然嘴皮子有点碎，但也是因为大家太熟了。
“给你介绍一下，我寝室的同学，老大李牧，二哥司马仪，老三范建国，都是学长，以后有什么事儿都可以找他们！”白启介绍到。
“三位学长好，我是赵悠儿，小白哥的邻居，大家可以叫我悠悠，以后请多多关照。”
在四位骑士的护送下，赵悠儿确实少了很多的干扰，一路上不少学长的眼睛都放绿光了，即便是这样，新生来了一位超级美女的消息还是很快扩散开来。
把赵悠儿送到学校女留学生的宿舍楼门外，四位骑士就被满脸警惕的舍管大妈给拦住了。
一行人只好在宿舍楼门口道别，几个牲口那叫一个恋恋不舍，当然了女生宿舍是男生永远的圣地。
“悠悠，晚上给你接风洗尘，记得来！”小白挥手说道。
“好，电话联系。”赵悠儿笑了笑，拿出手机晃了一下，倩丽的身影就消失在门后。
“还看什么看，快走快走！”舍管大妈就像护小鸡的母鸡一样，连轰带赶的把李牧一行人给弄走了。
“god，这是女神啊！那颜值，那身材，那气质！啧啧啧！我给101分，多给1分不怕她骄傲！”回头走了两步，司马仪就忍不住夸张的挥舞起双手，忍不住往回看了一眼。
“啊，小薰你来了！”
“啊？”司马仪简直就像是条件反射似的一缩头，小辫子如同一样炸起，整个人好像都哆嗦了一下，“咦，哪儿呢？”
“没有啊。我就是这么一说么。”范建国笑的更坏了。
“范建，你作死是不是！”司马仪怒道。
范建国耸耸肩，“我跟你没说，这悠儿同学绝对不得了！”
试着学了赵悠儿的样子抬起右腿，结果勉强只踢到膝盖高度，还差点弄得自己摔了一跤。
“哈哈哈！我说老三，跪求别秀！你再秀我肚皮都笑破了！”司马仪顿时捂着肚子眼泪都笑出来了。
“嘿！我不就是比划个意思么？哪能跟人家比？一看人家就是练过的。小白，你这邻家妹妹可太厉害了，我看男朋友不好找啊。”范建国倒是不在意几个人的调侃，扭头又一本正经对小白说道，男人也是八卦的，尤其是遇到美女。
“这个我也不清楚，或许有吧，如果没有的话，牧哥你可以抓紧抓紧。”小白笑道。
李牧还没开口，一旁的司马仪就打断了这痴心妄想，“千万别，我们家老牧驾驭不了这样的，这绝对是红颜祸水级别的，没霸王之能最好别招惹，老牧，不是瞧不起你，这样的姑娘我都要退避三舍。”
“司马，你这话我就不爱听，你的意思是牧哥不如你了，牧哥，我不知道山东人什么脾气，反正我不能忍，一会儿到了宿舍我给你把门，好好治治他！
（下一更晚上七点）
content_en:
At this moment, Zhao Youer suddenly took a step forward, dodged An Lushan's claws, turned around using the suitcase as an axis, and kicked out, diagonally upwards at a forty-five-degree angle!
Bang~~~~~~
The man in sunglasses, whose jaw was severely injured, fell to the ground, holding his head and groaning. Li Mu and others have arrived, and they are also stunned. This roundhouse kick is quite good. It turns out that it is not only slender...
"You blinded your dog eyes and ran to the gate of our school to act like a hooligan. Are you seeking death?" Li Mu and others chased after him unceremoniously and tried to make up for it. Did this bastard think that all the boys in the Shanghai Government were dead?
"Hey! Okay! You are in the same group! Do you want me to dance with my brother? Okay! Wait, you will feel better!" The man in sunglasses who fell on the ground took out his mobile phone and started taking pictures, "You guys are good at college students beating people! I have someone in the police station! Just wait, I will take your last name if you don't drop out of school!"
Xiaobai and the others looked at each other. They were not afraid of meeting an old man. But Zhao Youer came to Shanghai to study abroad, so he couldn't be punished before he entered the school.
While everyone was hesitating, Li Mu smiled happily, "Tsk, tsk, see you soon, idiot, look at that door number, what kind of school is this!"
"Shanghai...Hudong University of Political Science and Law." The man in sunglasses was dumbfounded,...it's not an art school...
You look like this and don’t do art? ? ?
"I've seen stupid people, but I've never seen a hooligan play like this." Li Mu waved his hand nonchalantly to the man in sunglasses, and then pointed to the traffic light at the intersection, "The car is parked on the sidewalk and reverses. You can do it! Do you know the surveillance area? Do you need to take pictures with your mobile phone here? Forced indecency, or in public, this is an aggravating circumstance, brothers, we are all witnesses, this will last for many years, give him free education!"
"According to Article 237 of the Criminal Law, you have been behaving like this for about five years. It's okay. You will still be a good man after you come out!" Xiaobai cooperated tacitly and immediately took it and said. In fact, how could he remember it so clearly?
"Brother, you have a pretty good figure and are quite white. You should be popular when you get in." Sima Yi said with a bad smile, saying that the man in sunglasses tightened his anus and made some parts of him even whiter.
"Don't talk to him, just call 110. This kind of social scum should have been recycled a long time ago!" Fan Jianguo took out his mobile phone.
The man in sunglasses was pale. He was not stupid. He didn't think his trouble was big. Being beaten up without taking any advantage was like bumping into the police. "Brothers, I was wrong. I was really wrong. I don't dare to do it anymore. I'm leaving. I'm leaving right away."
The man in sunglasses who was lying on the ground got up, jumped into the car in three steps at a time, and drove away in a hurry. I think he would take a detour when passing by here in the future.
"Thank you, four seniors. This is the east gate of Hudong Politics and Law, right?" Zhao Youer looked at the four of them, showing a bright smile and pleasing little white teeth, and bowed.
The four of them were stunned. This smile really had a charming temperament. Her beautiful big eyes revealed a hint of cunning. Beauty was one thing. Zhao Youer did have an indescribable style that made people want to get close to her.
This is definitely a difficult elf schoolgirl to deal with.
"Yuyou, I haven't seen her become a beautiful woman in a few years. Why can't she recognize her? I'm Bai Qi!" Xiaobai couldn't help laughing, but this girl didn't recognize her yet.
"Brother Xiaobai, I'm kidding you, if you come later, I will be in danger." Zhao Youer said.
"If we come late, he will be in danger." Li Mu couldn't help but say, this girl definitely has a temper. Most people would just scold each other away. She was a KO when she came up, but it was really fun.
"That handsome move just now, walking, roundhouse kick, all done in one go, like a blind monk!" Sima Yi couldn't help but praise, it's a pity, he has a master, otherwise he would definitely chase after such a beauty.
Although classmate Sima Yi is a bit arrogant, it is because everyone is so familiar with him.
"Let me introduce to you, the classmates in my dormitory, the eldest brother Li Mu, the second brother Sima Yi, and the third brother Fan Jianguo are all seniors. You can contact them if you need anything in the future!" Bai Qi introduced.
"Hello, three seniors, I am Zhao Youer, Brother Xiaobai's neighbor. You can call me Youyou. Please take good care of me in the future."
Under the escort of the four knights, Zhao Youer did have less interference. Many seniors' eyes glowed green along the way. Even so, the news of a super beauty among the new students spread quickly.
After sending Zhao Youer outside the dormitory of the school's female international students, the four knights were stopped by the wary-looking dormitory aunt.
The group of people had no choice but to say goodbye at the door of the dormitory building. Several animals were reluctant to leave. Of course, the girls' dormitory is the eternal holy place for boys.
"Yuyou, I'll take care of you tonight, remember to come!" Xiaobai waved his hand.
"Okay, call me." Zhao Youer smiled, took out her phone and shook it, and Qianli's figure disappeared behind the door.
"What are you looking at? Come on, come on!" Like a hen guarding her chicks, the housekeeper drove Li Mu and his group away.
"God, this is a goddess! That appearance, that figure, that temperament! Tsk tsk tsk! I give it 101 points, give her 1 more point to make her proud!" After taking two steps back, Sima Yi couldn't help but wave his hands in an exaggerated way, and couldn't help but glance back.
"Ah, Xiaoxun, you're here!"
"Ah?" Sima Yi shrank his head as if out of conditioned reflex, his pigtails bursting out, and his whole body seemed to tremble, "Hey, where are they?"
"No. Is that what I said?" Fan Jianguo smiled even worse.
"Fan Jian, are you seeking death?" Sima Yi said angrily.
Fan Jianguo shrugged, "I didn't tell you, this student You'er is absolutely incredible!"
He tried to imitate Zhao You'er and raised his right leg, but he could barely reach the height of his knee and almost made himself fall.
"Hahaha! I'm the third child, please stop showing off! If you show off your belly again, I'll burst out laughing!" Sima Yi immediately burst into tears while holding her stomach.
"Hey! I'm just making gestures, isn't it? How can I compare with others? You can see that she has practiced. Xiaobai, your girl next door is so amazing. I think it's hard to find a boyfriend." Fan Jianguo didn't care about the teasing of a few people. He turned around and said to Xiaobai seriously. Men also gossip, especially when they meet beautiful women.
"I don't know about this. Maybe there is. If not, Brother Mu, you can hurry up." Xiaobai said with a smile.
Before Li Mu could speak, Sima Yi on the side interrupted this wishful thinking, "Don't, our Lao Mu can't control this. This is definitely a beauty that is a disaster. If you don't have the ability to be a king, it's best not to mess with her. Lao Mu, I'm not looking down on you. I will stay away from girls like this."
"Sima, I don't like hearing what you said. You mean that Brother Mu is not as good as you. Brother Mu, I don't know what kind of temper Shandong people have. Anyway, I can't bear it. When I get to the dormitory later, I will open the door for you and treat him well!"
(Next update at 7pm)
